title: harnessbench model-run measurements (runs/<id>/data/model_results.json)
description: One record per measurement of a model bench round. Labels are kept exactly as the raw capture recorded them; nothing is renamed or reinterpreted.

leg.description: group this measurement belongs to — the tag prefix before the first dash (a-1 -> a, a1-2 -> a1); warm-up rows keep leg "warm", agentic showdown rounds keep leg "agent_phase"

tag.description: raw label from the capture, verbatim

in_tok.description: prompt tokens actually processed; null when the capture did not record it

out_tok.description: generated tokens; null when the capture did not record it

pp.description: prefill speed — input tokens/s; null only on an agent_phase row whose telemetry was not captured (rows: [] is not allowed, so such a round carries one null-speed row)

tps.description: decode speed — output tokens/s; null under the same condition as pp

draft.description: draft tokens offered, only recorded by speculative-decoding rounds
